name: Juggler Dev
intro: You looked at me! I saw you look! Okay so, quantum astrology, right, it is basically that every star sign is also every other star sign until you check...
...which is why I juggle. Anyway. Astral clash?
defeat: Mercury must be in something.
after: I dropped all three. I never drop all three.

name: Fire-Spinner Lola
intro: Careful, the poi are lit. So am I. Let us dance!
defeat: You burn brighter than my paraffin.
after: DJ Diabolo plays the Poi Pit. He never stops for water. Remember that.

name: Astra-Zero
intro: Namaste. It is Chad, from the charter flight. I go by Astra-Zero now.
I achieved ego death at the airport. It was easy. Daddy wired me a premium Astral, look.
defeat: Whatever. Winning is attachment. I am beyond attachment.
after: I am not ignoring you. I am practising non-engagement.

name: Astra-Zero
intro: Namaste. It is Chad, from the charter flight. I go by Astra-Zero now.
I achieved ego death at the airport. It was easy. Daddy wired me a premium Astral, look.
defeat: Whatever. Winning is attachment. I am beyond attachment.
after: I am not ignoring you. I am practising non-engagement.

name: Astra-Zero
intro: Namaste. It is Chad, from the charter flight. I go by Astra-Zero now.
I achieved ego death at the airport. It was easy. Daddy wired me a premium Astral, look.
defeat: Whatever. Winning is attachment. I am beyond attachment.
after: I am not ignoring you. I am practising non-engagement.

name: Raver Miko
intro: Did you feel that drop? No? It has not happened yet. It is ABOUT to. Fight me before it does!
defeat: The drop... was inside you all along.
after: Diabolo is all Stimulant and Organic. Something Dissociative would wobble him.

name: Wook Sandy
intro: Hey... do you have a spare... anything? No? Then we clash, I guess.
defeat: Far out. Got a spare rematch?
after: I have been on this dancefloor since the last festival.

name: DJ Diabolo
intro: YOU. On my stage. During my set. I have been mixing for nineteen hours and I will not be interrupted by anything less than an astral clash.
One, two, one-two-three-four!
defeat: ...The record skipped. Nobody has made my record skip since 2011.
Take the Hemp String Wristband. Your Organic and Stimulant Astrals can hack through fairy lights with it.
after: The road north to the Tantric Yurt is choked with fairy lights. Not for you, now.

name: Yogi Anand
intro: Breathe in. Hold. Hold. Hold. Oh, you are still here? Then we clash.
defeat: And... exhale.
after: Svetlana sits inside the yurt. Her Astrals are all Psychedelic. Bring a Bummer.

name: Hippie Sol
intro: Brother! Sister! Being! I can see your aura. It needs a wash. Let me help.
defeat: Clean as a whistle.
after: The market is east of here. Do not buy the Himalayan Kush. It is oregano.

name: Acolyte Mira
intro: Nobody approaches the Guru without first approaching themselves. And then me.
defeat: You have approached... adequately.
after: She is ready for you.

name: Guru Svetlana
intro: Sit. No, not there. That is where the energy sits.
You came for a wristband. But have you asked what the wristband wants? Let us ask it together, on the astral plane.
defeat: The wristband wants... you. How embarrassing for me.
Take the Quartz Wristband. A Psychedelic Astral can now light up dark places. The road north of the market is very dark.
after: I told security at the market to let you through. Captain Keta is north. He is somewhere near his body, usually.

name: Dealer Vik
intro: Psst. Himalayan Kush. Hand-picked by monks. Very spiritual, very oregano... I mean organic. You are not buying? Then you are a problem.
defeat: Team Undercover will hear about this.
after: We are taking the whole festival. All that lovely dopamine. You will see.

name: Guard Pinto
intro: Halt. This road is closed for a private event. The event is me standing here.
defeat: I did not see you. You did not see me.
after: Team Undercover pays better than the festival. That is all I will say.

name: Dealer Raz
intro: You have a torch? Turn it off. Turn it OFF. Fine. We do this the hard way.
defeat: Nobody was supposed to find this stash.
after: There is something hidden further up the road. I am not telling you where.

name: Raver Jun
intro: Is this the afterparty? It is so dark. I love it. I cannot find my feet. Fight me!
defeat: Found my feet. They were on my legs.
after: The Ditch is just ahead. Mind the scooters.

name: Mechanic Dinesh
intro: Forty scooters went into this ditch. I have fixed none of them. I blame Astrals. Yours, specifically.
defeat: Maybe it is the carburettors.
after: Captain Keta has not stood up straight in years. His Astrals are all wobble. Use something Organic or Psychedelic.

name: Tourist Brenda
intro: Excuse me, do you work here? No? Well somebody has to take responsibility for this ditch.
defeat: I shall be leaving a review.
after: One star. Would not fall in again.

name: Captain Keta
intro: Ahoy... is the ditch moving, or is it me? It is me. I am the ditch.
You want the keychain. Everyone wants the keychain. Nobody asks how the keychain is doing. Prepare to be... prepare to... hold on.
defeat: Oh. I was upside down the whole time.
Here. The Wonky Keychain. A Downer or Organic Astral can shove the heavy things now. Subwoofers. Wooks. That sort of thing.
after: There is a subwoofer blocking the east side of the market. Give it a shove. Tell it the Captain sent you.

name: Wook Bodhi
intro: I have been in this queue since Tuesday. You are not cutting in.
defeat: Okay you can cut in.
after: Extra cheese. Always extra cheese.

name: Raver Pix
intro: The thicket! The thicket goes to the forest stage! But there is foam! SO MUCH FOAM! Fight!
defeat: I slipped.
after: You need to float to get through the thicket. Raju stamps people who can float.

name: Astra-Zero
intro: Oh. You. I have been doing a silent retreat. I broke it to tell you how well it is going.
My Astrals did a sound bath. They are basically vibrating at a higher tax bracket.
defeat: I let you win. To teach you about winning.
after: Raju only cooks for people with three wristbands. I have a note from my father.

name: Astra-Zero
intro: Oh. You. I have been doing a silent retreat. I broke it to tell you how well it is going.
My Astrals did a sound bath. They are basically vibrating at a higher tax bracket.
defeat: I let you win. To teach you about winning.
after: Raju only cooks for people with three wristbands. I have a note from my father.

name: Astra-Zero
intro: Oh. You. I have been doing a silent retreat. I broke it to tell you how well it is going.
My Astrals did a sound bath. They are basically vibrating at a higher tax bracket.
defeat: I let you win. To teach you about winning.
after: Raju only cooks for people with three wristbands. I have a note from my father.

name: Chef Raju
intro: Five in the morning. Everybody is hungry, nobody has money, and you want a wristband instead of an omelette.
Fine. But I cook while we fight. Do not get shell in it.
defeat: Perfectly done. Not the omelette. You.
The Extra Cheese Stamp. With a Dissociative Astral you can float across foam pits and shallows. Take this too, I found it in the fryer.
after: The sea north of the Scooter Ditch leads to the lake and the forest. So does the thicket behind my stall. Mind the bass up there.

name: Hippie Rain
intro: The lake is fresh water, you know. Ten metres from the sea. Nobody can explain it. I can, but it takes six hours. Or we clash.
defeat: It is the mud. Definitely the mud.
after: The forest stage is south. You will hear it before you see it. You will feel it before you hear it.

name: Yogi Padma
intro: I am doing a mud cleanse. You have disturbed the mud. The mud demands a clash.
defeat: The mud forgives you.
after: The mud forgets nothing.

name: Darkpsy Disciple Zed
intro: ONE NINETY! ONE NINETY! Can your heart do one ninety? Mine can! I checked! FIGHT!
defeat: One... sixty... is fine.
after: The Baron plays facing away from the crowd. Walk round the stage.

name: Guard Lobo
intro: Team Undercover security. This stage is being decommissioned for noise. And for joy. Mostly joy.
defeat: The Sergeant will not like this.
after: Our Sergeant is up on the Sunset Cliff. He is fencing off the view.

name: Baron Von Darkpsy
intro: You approach the Baron from the front. Nobody approaches the Baron from the front. It is where the dread comes out.
Very well. One hundred and ninety beats per minute. Each one, a small ending.
defeat: ...A major chord. In MY forest.
The UV Skeleton Band. A Stimulant Astral can now chew through padlocked VIP fences. There is one south of the market.
after: Leave me. I must find a darker key.

name: Wook Moss
intro: I live here now. In the bamboo. This is my bamboo.
defeat: It was always our bamboo.
after: The foam pit ate my sandals.

name: Fire-Spinner Ash
intro: Fire and bamboo. What could go wrong? Clash with me before we find out!
defeat: Something went wrong.
after: Raju's stall is south. The forest is north. I am on fire. Slightly.

name: Guard Dsouza
intro: VIP corridor. Wristband check. No, not those wristbands. The ones that cost money.
defeat: You are on the list now. A different list.
after: Team Undercover owns everything past this fog.

name: Dealer Moe
intro: Balloons! Get your balloons! First one is free, second one is a clash!
defeat: They always pop.
after: Chloe pays us to keep the riff-raff off her cliff. You are riff. Possibly raff.

name: Influencer Jax
intro: Oh my god you are SO authentic. Can I film you losing? It is for a reel.
defeat: Delete that. DELETE THAT.
after: The sunset is at the end of the corridor. Sponsored, obviously.

name: Influencer Bex
intro: You are in my shot. You have been in my shot for an hour. I am going to need you to clash or leave.
defeat: Golden hour is ruined.
after: Chloe has the best spot. She had it fenced.

name: Sergeant Baksheesh
intro: So you are the barefoot nobody who keeps tripping over my operation.
Team Undercover has bottled half the dopamine at this festival. The free party ends tonight. After I end you.
defeat: Impossible. I had a permit. I wrote it myself.
Take the bottles. Give it all back, see if I care. Team Undercover is finished. I am going to open a guest house.

name: Influencer Chloe
intro: Hi guys! So today we are at the most EXCLUSIVE sunset in Goa, and... sorry, who let this person in?
Okay you know what, this is great content. Astral clash at golden hour. Smash that like button.
defeat: My engagement... it has never been this high. People LOVE watching me lose.
Here, take the VIP Press Pass. Tuk-tuks will take you to any Chai Tent you have visited. And the sadhu at the sea cave will let you in.
after: Baba Smoke lives in the cave north of the shallows. He refused to collab. Twice.

name: Yogi Dhruv
intro: I have held this pose for eleven days. Do not make me come out of it. Fine. I am coming out of it.
defeat: Back to the pose.
after: Baba has not spoken in years. He communicates in smoke. And clashes.

name: Disciple Tara
intro: The pattern in the east chamber has been watching us. It is watching you now. Show it something.
defeat: It blinked.
after: If you light the dark, you may see the pattern in the rock. Bring your best vials.

name: Baba Smoke
intro: (He exhales. The smoke forms a question mark, then a wristband, then a very rude gesture.)
defeat: (The smoke forms a small round of applause.)
(He presses a thumb of ash to your forehead. With an Organic or Psychedelic Astral you can now climb banyan roots.)
after: (The smoke spells BACKSTAGE, with an arrow.)

name: Bouncer Tiny
intro: Name? Not on the list. Nobody is on the list. There is no list. There is only me.
defeat: You are on the list.
after: The Promoter has not left that chair since the festival began. Nobody knows which festival.

name: Bouncer Mountain
intro: The temple is that way. You are this way. I am in between. Do the maths.
defeat: I never liked maths.
after: Only an All-Access Hologram gets you past the rope.

name: The Promoter
intro: Seven wristbands. Barefoot. No passport. You are exactly the kind of story I can sell.
But I do not give All-Access. I license it. Let us negotiate, on the astral plane. I always win negotiations.
defeat: ...I am going to need that in writing. No. No, I am not. You won.
The All-Access Hologram. The rope behind me opens onto the Mainstage Temple. The Four-on-the-Floor are waiting, and behind them the Shaman Council. And your passport.
after: Go on. Before I think of a clause.

name: Kick Kalyani
intro: First of the Four-on-the-Floor. I am the kick drum. I land on every beat, and I land heavy.
Nobody dances without me. Nobody passes without me.
defeat: You kept time. Go on. The bassline is next.

name: Bassline Boris
intro: Second. I am the bassline. I fill the gaps between her kicks, and I make the floor feel like the deck of a ship.
Try to stand up straight.
defeat: You found your sea legs. The hi-hat will try to rush you.

name: Hi-Hat Hana
intro: Third-third-third! I am the hi-hat, I am the offbeat, I am the reason your leg will not stop doing that!
Fast-fast-fast, here we go!
defeat: Okay. Okay okay okay. You are faster. The lead is last. She gets in your head.

name: Lead Lakshmi
intro: Fourth. I am the lead line. The melody you will still be humming when you are eighty.
The others move your body. I only want your mind. Hold on to it if you can.
defeat: A clean resolve. The Council is beyond. But there is somebody in the doorway. He has been there a while.

name: Astra-Zero
intro: You. Of course it is you.
I got here yesterday. The Council would not see me. They said my ego was "not dead, just very well dressed".
So I am going to stand in this doorway until one of us has a breakthrough. On the astral plane. Come on.
defeat: I did not achieve ego death at the airport. I bought a book about it. I did not finish the book.
Go on in. Get your passport. I think... I think I am going to go and find some water.

name: Astra-Zero
intro: You. Of course it is you.
I got here yesterday. The Council would not see me. They said my ego was "not dead, just very well dressed".
So I am going to stand in this doorway until one of us has a breakthrough. On the astral plane. Come on.
defeat: I did not achieve ego death at the airport. I bought a book about it. I did not finish the book.
Go on in. Get your passport. I think... I think I am going to go and find some water.

name: Astra-Zero
intro: You. Of course it is you.
I got here yesterday. The Council would not see me. They said my ego was "not dead, just very well dressed".
So I am going to stand in this doorway until one of us has a breakthrough. On the astral plane. Come on.
defeat: I did not achieve ego death at the airport. I bought a book about it. I did not finish the book.
Go on in. Get your passport. I think... I think I am going to go and find some water.

name: Undercover Grunt Ravi
intro: Room inspection. Team Undercover is buying this place, bed by bed. You are not in the brochure.
defeat: Fine. Take the memo. I was going to shred it anyway. Probably.
after: I am only here for the free breakfast now.

name: Selector Nandini
intro: You walked into my booth mid-set. Bold. Let us see if you can keep a beat.
defeat: Okay. Okay. You can stay for the drop.
after: The Baron plays facing away from the crowd. I play facing the exit.

name: Assistant Pippa
intro: This villa is a content house. You are not content. You are noise.
defeat: Ugh. Fine. Do not read the memo on the table. Unless you want to.
after: Chloe says the sunset belongs to us now. I just do the captions.

name: Bottler Kiran
intro: Green room. Bottles only. You are not a bottle.
defeat: The safe is behind the subwoofers. Not that I am telling you.
after: The speakers only move if you shove them from the right side.

name: Bottler Meera
intro: Every drop of joy in Goa goes through this room. Back off.
defeat: The Promoter is going to notice the bottles are light.
after: You should not be in here. Nobody should be in here. That is the point of a green room.

name: DJ Diabolo
offer: You again. I have been practising. With fire this time. Want to go again?
intro: No holding back this time.
defeat: Fine. You really are that good. Come back when you want to feel something.
after: The road north to the Tantric Yurt is choked with fairy lights. Not for you, now.

name: Guru Svetlana
offer: My chakras have realigned since you embarrassed me. Shall we test them?
intro: No holding back this time.
defeat: Fine. You really are that good. Come back when you want to feel something.
after: I told security at the market to let you through. Captain Keta is north. He is somewhere near his body, usually.

name: Captain Keta
offer: The ditch remembers you. So do I. Round two?
intro: No holding back this time.
defeat: Fine. You really are that good. Come back when you want to feel something.
after: There is a subwoofer blocking the east side of the market. Give it a shove. Tell it the Captain sent you.

name: Chef Raju
offer: New menu. Same chef. Hungry for another loss? Mine, I mean. Yours, I hope.
intro: No holding back this time.
defeat: Fine. You really are that good. Come back when you want to feel something.
after: The sea north of the Scooter Ditch leads to the lake and the forest. So does the thicket behind my stall. Mind the bass up there.

name: Baron Von Darkpsy
offer: I have turned round. I am facing the crowd now. Face me.
intro: No holding back this time.
defeat: Fine. You really are that good. Come back when you want to feel something.
after: Leave me. I must find a darker key.

name: Influencer Chloe
offer: My engagement dipped after you. I need a rematch for the content.
intro: No holding back this time.
defeat: Fine. You really are that good. Come back when you want to feel something.
after: Baba Smoke lives in the cave north of the shallows. He refused to collab. Twice.

name: Baba Smoke
offer: The smoke has thickened, child. Come and sit in it again.
intro: No holding back this time.
defeat: Fine. You really are that good. Come back when you want to feel something.
after: (The smoke spells BACKSTAGE, with an arrow.)

name: The Promoter
offer: The festival is free again. I hate it. Let me lose properly this time.
intro: No holding back this time.
defeat: Fine. You really are that good.
Listen. Under the speaker stacks, at the back. Something has been humming since you beat me the first time. I think it wants a word.
after: Go on. Before I think of a clause.
